## Current objective
Fix JPY rounding in `ledgerly/money.py`. PDF migration is paused/superseded. Credential rotation steps 6–8 remain.

- SQLAlchemy pool size 50: caused lock contention and deadlocks.
- Nested `args.filters["currency"]`; use canonical `args.currency`.
- Command-specific billing argument groups; use shared helpers.
- Per-document embedding clients; use the shared client.
- Tenant-less invoice scans; use `Invoice.for_tenant`.

## Recent work
Search rebuilding was optimized with chunking, tenant scoping, shared embedding, and bulk upserts. Full suite: 247 passed, 4 skipped; benchmark median improved from 16.73s to 2.41s. CSV export now explicitly uses UTF-8; all 7 tests pass.
